subject: Automate evidence TTL + presigned upload webhook for Vendr/Whistic sync
messages:
From: Alex Graham <alex.graham@bluepeak.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal: presigned uploads + TTL webhook question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Two quick asks from our security team as we finish the Whistic/Vendr proof-of-possession handoff:

1) We need uploads to your evidence bucket to be presigned (short TTL) and have a lifecycle webhook so items are automatically marked expired in the portal after 90 days unless re-asserted. BluePeak's SOC2 policy requires explicit TTLs & proof rotation for ephemeral artifacts.

2) Is there an existing webhook event Redwood can emit when you rotate or revoke presign tokens (so we can sync our local inventory)? If not, would you consider a lightweight POST webhook from Vendr -> our endpoint on successful upload + expiry timestamp?

We attached the security team's TTL requirements (bluepeak-ttl-requirements.pdf) and a quick diagram. Can you confirm feasibility and next steps (owners and ETA)?

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Graham
Security Engineering, BluePeak
security@bluepeak.io
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Graham <alex.graham@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: presigned uploads + TTL webhook question

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the PDF.

Short answer: yes, we can support presigned uploads and emit a webhook on upload completion + TTL metadata. A few clarifications so we scope correctly:

- Are you asking for 90-day TTL by default for all artifacts, or per-artifact-type (e.g., SOC2 report = 365d, system diagrams = 90d)? The PDF implies mixed TTLs.
- We can emit two webhook events: upload.completed (with presign id + expiry) and evidence.expired (when our rotation job marks it expired). Do you need both?
- For governance, we can provide a signed activity log entry (HMAC header) on each webhook call so you can verify authenticity.

Marissa / Jonas — can you look at the presign pattern in Vendr and estimate effort to: 1) add TTL metadata to the presign response, 2) emit upload.completed webhook, and 3) add scheduled evidence.expired event from our retention job?

Alex — target ETA depends on complexity. If you can confirm TTL mapping per artifact type, we can propose an implementation plan and a small PoC (Lambda + webhook consumer) within 10 business days.

Thanks,
Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: presigned uploads + TTL webhook question

Adding a bit more technical detail / proposal:

- Presign response change: include metadata {artifact_type, ttl_seconds, presign_id}. Presign IDs are already generated; we can add TTL in the manifest returned to the client.
- upload.completed webhook: POST to customer endpoint with JSON payload: {presign_id, artifact_type, uploaded_at, expires_at, s3_key}. We'll HMAC-sign the payload.
- evidence.expired event: our nightly retention sweep currently deletes temp artifacts older than 30 days; we can extend to generate evidence.expired instead of immediate deletion and emit the event per artifact. Deletion policy remains configurable per account.

Estimated effort: presign metadata + webhook (2 dev days + 1 QA day). retention job emit (1 dev day + 1 ops review). I'll prototype a Lambda that responds to presign creation and simulates the webhook flow.

Attachments: presign-flow-sketch.png (simple sequence diagram).

I'll draft the PoC and share a short runbook for BluePeak to consume the webhook (HMAC verification, retry logic, idempotency).

—Marissa
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Graham <alex.graham@bluepeak.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: presigned uploads + TTL webhook question

Sounds good — looping in implementation details and runbook timeline.

Action items:
- Alex: confirm TTL mapping per artifact type (e.g., SOC2 report=365d, SysArch=180d, screenshots/log-snippets=90d) by EOD Mon 7/23.
- Marissa: prototype presign metadata + upload.completed webhook PoC (target 7/31).
- Jonas: add evidence.expired emitter to nightly retention sweep and provide runbook for customers on how to re-assert evidence before expiry (target 8/4).
- Kimberly: coordinate updated Whistic/Vendr docs and provide example HMAC verification snippet for BluePeak.

Notes on security: we will include an x-redwood-signature HMAC header and timestamp to prevent replay; webhook URLs must be HTTPS and allow client cert validation if BluePeak requires it.

Alex, if that timeline looks acceptable I'll convert this into a small mutual action plan and send over a DocuSign for the SLA addendum (short-term POA for the PoC).

Thanks — Jonas
